text:
[LGRA.5.8.8] **A float zero in a `Json` value has no sign.** Every float zero a
`Json` value holds is `+0.0`. Wherever a `Json` value comes into being, at each
place [LGRA.5.8.6] lists, a runtime **must** make every float `-0.0` inside it
`+0.0`.

The zero stays a float: an integer `0` and a float `0.0` are still different
kinds ([LFAC.2.5.1]). Outside a `Json` value nothing changes: a `Float` slot
keeps `-0.0`, and so do its text forms ([LDET.3.2.7]).

So a leaf read of a JSON `-0.0` is `+0.0`, a `Json` value's canonical text
carries no `-0.0`, and a recording read on replay holds the value the live
run held.

idris.name: lgra_5_8_8__fold_float
idris.note: The fold on one float, its decision taken first: +0.0 when the float is a zero of either sign, the float itself otherwise.

idris.name: lgra_5_8_8__fold_leaves_no_negative_zero
idris.note: For every float: a zero of either sign folds to +0.0 and a nonzero float is itself; an integer 0 stays an integer.

idris.name: lgra_5_8_8__unsigned_zeros
idris.note: Every float zero a document holds made +0.0, at every depth, an integer 0 and every nonzero value untouched: the fold the clause has a runtime apply wherever a `Json` value comes into being. The fixture runner applies it to every document it reads, and the fixture lowering to every one it codes.

idris.name: lgra_5_8_8__unsigned_zeros_list
idris.note: The fold over an array's elements.

idris.name: lgra_5_8_8__unsigned_zeros_members
idris.note: The fold over an object's members.
